title: Coin Hop
summary: A 2D platformer seen from the side: ledges, jumps and coins on a tile map written in the spec.

verified.result: PASS gates 6/6, measures 22/22 (9 is the flat sheet, and ran)
verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from coin-hop, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> (a build verify, every build measure; 165 s) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU (CHROME_ARGS="--use-gl=angle --use-angle=gl-egl"); the verdict is builder/gates/verdict.schema.json's and valid against it
